We specialize in mission-critical applications for interactive visual communications for safety, security and disaster management. AnsuR's software solutions help communicate high-precision geo-tagged visual content using minimum bandwidth with the aim to help increase situational understanding, decrease reaction time and save resources.

AnsuR has been working with emergency responders, police forces, civil security, military organisations and commercial companies to provide software that can deliver high-precision mission-critical visual communication under any circumstance, even through low bandwidth and satellite communications.

AnsuR software enables for visual data to be communicated with up to 99% less bandwidth than traditional methods, providing fast situational awareness regardless of how low or unstable the available network is. We provide applications which enable fast visual data collection and dissemination through smartphones, tablets, computers and UAVs, as well as embedded solutions for live streaming from video cameras and beyond-line-of-sight UAVs.

Pese a todo, nuevos tiempos precisan unas nuevas estrategias, y en ello estamos. Con vuestra ayuda y colaboración vamos a superar las dificultades presentes, para hacer de nuestro Colegio-Asociación la más valiosa herramienta al servicio de todos vosotros: los Ingenieros Técnicos de Telecomunicación.

Name: UNICO5G Timing
Description:
TIMING is a project funded by the Ministerio de Asuntos Económicos y Transformación Digital and the European Union – NextGenerationEU. TIMING aims to design, implement, and validate a solution to enable e2e reliable TSN services supported by operators’ infrastructures that are currently carrying on a best effort basis. TIMING has identified Industry 4.0 as a key vertical.

TIMING will analyze and develop solutions to support TSN in the Ethernet and Wi-Fi segments and identify the enhancements to be made for supporting the sub-millisecond latency for TSN systems. Scheduling solutions to support these enhancements will be developed and assessed. In addition, solutions to automate the deployment of e2e TSN services with assured performance will be designed, developed, and assessed. Such service automation relies on a control plane, which will include a TSN controller able to control and monitor Ethernet and Wi-Fi TSN nodes, a TSN Connectivity Manager to provide e2e connectivity across TSN and non-TSN segments, and a QoS estimation tool that includes accurate TSN traffic models. The different components will be integrated and to build to validate the whole architecture.

Description:
Green Interlink INC is a firm specialized in telecom asset lifecycle management, headquartered in Panama City with operational presence in Spain, Colombia, and more than 10 countries worldwide.

We bridge two markets that rarely connect: telecom operators retiring end-of-life network equipment, and certified recyclers and refineries that recover the strategic metals contained within them.

For telecom operators, we provide end-to-end valuation, dismantling, and reverse logistics services for network assets — including 4G/5G BBUs, RRUs, antennas, backbone routers, MSC switching systems, power equipment, and fiber infrastructure. Our valuation platform indexes prices in real time against LME and LBMA metal markets, ensuring full transparency and maximum financial recovery on assets that would otherwise depreciate with zero return.

For e-waste recyclers and scrap managers, we operate a marketplace for telecom-grade PCB board lots and electronic scrap, with automatic quotes based on the actual precious metal content: gold, silver, palladium, and copper. We connect lots directly to integrated refineries operating under the highest environmental compliance standards.

Our methodology combines chemical composition analysis by equipment family, live spot prices on international metal exchanges, and a global logistics network with a zero-landfill policy.

At Green Interlink, we believe every decommissioned tower, every retired board, and every recovered cable represents both an economic opportunity and a commitment to the circular economy.

At Parkifast, we have developed a technology that is able to seamlessly monitor the whole user’s mobility chain and thanks to artificial intelligence algorithms, we are able to process the raw data and extract very useful insights. The result is a real-time database that reflects how entire cities move everyday.

We offer to companies tree types of products:

- Parkifast Insights: with this tool a company can access the aggregated and anonymous mobility data of all Parkifast users, comprised by full mobility chains of citizens in real time, indicating not only where they are, but how they are moving: walking, by car, by bus, by train, etc. Some of the use cases we are working on are for on-street marketing, competition studies in retail, urban planning and traffic management. In addition, we include core information of the company such as parking monitoring in cities.

- Parkifast Analytics: thanks to Parkifast SDK, which is integratable in any third-party mobile app, our customers can monitor the mobility chain of their users through their own mobile applications, in real time and 24x7, with no physical barriers and without the need to deploy any kind of device that may require installation, permits and maintenance (icons, trackers, etc). The technology allows to know which user’s frequent places, detect fraudulent actions, study consumption patterns and achieve better insights about their customers than their competition.

- ParkiFaaS: Parkifast parking Feature integrated into third-party applications as-a-Service. So that any company can offer on-street parking information to their users, on their own mobile application.

Name: B5G-OPEN
Description:
B5G-OPEN targets the design, prototyping and demonstration of a novel end-to-end integrated packet-optical transport architecture based on MultiBand (MB) optical transmission and switching networks. MB expands the available capacity of optical fibres, by enabling transmission within S, E, and O bands, in addition to commercial C and/or C+L bands, which translates into a potential 10x capacity increase and low-latency for services beyond 5G.
To realize multiband networks, technology advances are required, both in data, control and management planes.
Concerning devices, these include new amplifiers, filterless subsystems, add/drop multiplexers, etc. Such technology advances complement novel packet-optical white boxes using flexible sliceable Bandwidth Variable Transceivers and novel pluggable optics. The availability of MB transmission will also lead to a complete redesign of the end-to-end architecture, removing boundaries between network domains and reducing electronic intermediate terminations.
The control plane will be extended to support multiband elements and a ‘domain-less’ network architecture. It will rely on physical layer abstraction, new impairment modelling, and pervasive telemetry data collection to feed AI/ML algorithms that will lead to a Zero-Touch networking paradigm including a full featured node operating system for packet-optical whiteboxes.
The results will be shown in two final demonstrations exposing the project benefits from operator and user perspectives.
B5G-OPEN will have a clear impact on the society showing the evolution towards a world with increased needs of connectivity and higher capacity in support of new B5G services and new traffic patterns.
The consortium includes partners from 8 countries: three major telecom operators, three vendors, four SMEs and four research centres and academia, combining several years of experience and a successful record in past European projects on related technologies, thus guaranteeing its success.

Name: 6G-EWOC
Description:
www.6g-ewoc.eu

The sixth generation (6G) of wireless communication technology is touted as an enabler of our digital age. It bears vast potentials for individuals and businesses to enhance opportunities and create new technologies in a wide range of sectors, including industrial manufacturing, energy supply, digital healthcare, government and education, and efficient transportation.

6G-EWOC contributes to this mission through its focus on autonomous driving. By connecting vehicles and making their collected information instantaneously available to all traffic participants, 6G provides a salient feature for safety and efficient transport on the road. 6G-EWOC contributes critical technologies:

- Optical wireless comms & sensing for situational awareness & connectivity
- Seamless access to edge datacentres through a high-capacity fiber fronthaul
- Real-time processing of the collected road-side data
- Orchestration of several constituents of 6G-enabled vehicular connectivity through artificial intelligence

The 6G-EWOC project has received funding from the Smart Networks and Services Joint Undertaking (SNS JU) under the EU’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under Grant Agreement No. 101139182. Nuestra visión
La conectividad es la nueva energía vital del mundo moderno. Queremos ser el operador que no solo conecta dispositivos, sino que conecta personas, culturas y oportunidades.

BitStream: Acceso indirecto sobre la red de fibra óptica GPON de Adamo, en el que se ofrece conectividad de nivel 2 de forma segura y transparente, desde el punto de interconexión con el cliente hasta el equipo terminal de red ONT en el domicilio del cliente final. 

Internet Marca Blanca: El servicio Internet Marca Blanca está diseñado para clientes que no dispongan de infraestructuras de telecomunicaciones propias, pero que deseen ofrecer a sus clientes finales servicios de acceso a Internet en nivel 3.

Internet Hybrid ACS: Diseñado para clientes que no dispongan de infraestructuras de telecomunicaciones propias y que deseen ofrecer a sus clientes finales servicios de acceso a Internet (nivel 3), pero que además precisen tener el control sobre la configuración en remoto de los equipos de cliente final. 

Interconexión: Conectividad a nivel físico y lógico entre el cliente y la red de Adamo, con acceso a peerings abiertos dentro de la red de Adamo y presencia en la mayoría de data centers del país.

Ethernet VPN: Define el acceso indirecto sobre la red MPLS de Adamo, en el que se ofrece conectividad de nivel 2, de forma segura y transparente, entre las sedes del cliente.

IP Transit: Tránsito IP a través del AS35699. Interconexión directa entre los equipos de red de Adamo y los del cliente, asignación de direccionamiento IP de los rangos de Adamo y opciones de entrega de una ruta por defecto o IP-Transit con full routing table BGP.

Wavelength: Ofrece transporte punto a punto transparente (Nivel 1) de datos a través de la red DWDM de Adamo. 

Fibra Oscura: Ofrece la posibilidad de disponer de canales de fibra óptica oscura para que el propio cliente la ilumine usando sus propios equipos.

Name: Perito Whatsapp
Description:
¿Cuál es el precio de un informe pericial de whatsapp?
El precio puede variar en función de los mensajes a recuperar en el caso que se hayan borrado o en la dificultad de la pericia forense que deba realizarse.

Podemos decir que los precios medios de una pericial de whatsapp mercado están entre los 500 eur y los 800 eur.

Debe quedar claro en el precio si incluye la presencia del perito en el juzgado en el caso de que sea necesario. Lo normal es cobrar un fijo por ir a juicio, en el caso que lo solicite el abogado. Debemos tener en cuenta que el perito se juega su prestigio en cada caso y puede ser condenado si no realiza correctamente su función.

En los casos el letrado solicita que el perito informático asista al juicio par ratificar el informe, en este caso se cobra un fijo para dicha asistencia de 300 eur , el IVA no está incluido en ninguno de nuestros precios.

De todas formas, cabe destacar que en el caso de ganar el juicio se puede puede pedir que la parte contraria sea condenada a costas, con lo cual tendrá que pagar los gastos de abogado y perito entre otros.

Además de los informes en algunos casos se requiere de un dictamen pericial donde el perito informático forense debe dar su opinión sobre un tema. En estos casos se requiere de una investigación previa, para la pericial.

La colaboración con los letrados es fundamental para los peritos cuando se trata de informe de parte, para saber lo que se pretende demostrar en cada caso.

Name: Grupo de Tratamiento de Imágenes
Description: The Grupo de Tratamiento de Imágenes (GTI) [Image Processing Group] is a research group working on theory, methods, and applications of Digital Image and Video Processing, mainly for compression and analysis. Besides specific developments on video related topics, GTI also considers research on complete systems like visual communications, real time computer vision, and multimedia telecom applications. Thus, GTI has developed facilities and toolkits for the design and implementation of video delivery systems and machine-learning based computer vision applications. Currently, GTI activity focuses on immersive video communications and extended (VR, MR, AR) and shared reality applications, including deep-learning for visual computing. GTI infrastructure includes three labs: a complete 3DTV laboratory (3DTV Lab) endowed with a 3D acquisition system, a 3D post-production system, and several 3D displays, a real-time free-viewpoint video laboratory (FVV Live) endowed with linear and planar camera configurations, lightweight schemes for video acquisition, transmission, and rendering, and minimal motion to photon latency, and an immersive laboratory (ImLab) for 360VR, volumetric video and extended/shared reality.

Barracuda is part of an integrated infrastructure model that combines:
• A 1,070 km open submarine cable system
• A neutral and open Cable Landing Station in Sagunto (Valencia)
• A high-availability, multipurpose Data Center designed for next-generation digital workloads

VDPC operates as a neutral infrastructure platform, enabling carriers, hyperscalers and international operators to expand their connectivity strategies across the Mediterranean region and beyond.

Our vision is to position Valencia as a strategic node in Europe’s evolving connectivity map.

The core of our business has always been the development of automation software for telecom testing labs. In 2008 we got the opportunity to become a member of the network of Telefónica External Laboratories and we started providing specialized services in relation with the ADSL technology and TR-069. While performing this work, we realized two facts: on one side it was a very repetitive and cumbersome work; and on the other hand, there was a big rotation of experienced engineers, so it was difficult to count with a team of skilled and specialized technicians performing this job without losing the know-how. With that insight, our company addressed the challenge and began designing and develope affordable software tools that could be used to solve the most common problem in CPE testing around the TR-069 protocol. 
Today, dBm Ingenieros is a leading innovator in diagnostic tools used for testing, optimizing and troubleshooting the TR-069 protocol in a CPE. dBm069 is the name of the range of tools that we have developed.
